text:
The condominium passes to Kathy by survivorship because the deed validly created a tenancy by the entirety, which severed the prior devise to Julie; the pasture land passes to Tommy under the will, and the remaining assets pass equally to Tommy and Julie. Kathy's prenuptial agreement bars any elective share, and the note's claim that a statutory share applies automatically to a later spouse is incorrect here because the waiver is valid and enforceable.  
CONFIDENCE: 90
